# Dickinson Wright

> > A full-service law firm with 450+ attorneys across North America offering 40 practice areas and 16 industry groups.

Dickinson Wright is a major North American law firm with offices spanning the United States and Canada. The firm specializes in construction law, intellectual property, banking and finance, litigation, and corporate services, serving clients across multiple industries.

## Key Topics

- Practice Areas

- Banking & Finance
